savings.reason: EO12817 section 4 gives completed-transfer acquittance, good-faith protection and preservation of pre-transfer rights, debts and claims. EO13350 section 1 saves prior actions/proceedings and matured rights/duties/penalties. Such accrued legal consequences are retained, without asserting a particular transfer occurred; no new transfer, investment, repayment or rulemaking command continues independently under EO12817.

research_rationale: Withdraw the complete exact-date claim and split section 8(a) effectiveness from section 8(b) congressional transmission and publication. EO13350 expressly revokes EO12817 effective July 30, 2004 at 12:01 a.m. EDT, but that does not give first-end dates for historical notice duties or prove no earlier partial legal change. Preserve the unresolved contrary leads to UNSCR1483 and OFAC575.533 rather than infer a May23,2003 whole ending. Resolution778 fund restoration/repaid assets remain expressly contemplated. No completion of every Treasury determination, transfer, investment, repayment or account is asserted. Sections4/7 and EO13350 accrued savings remain separately relevant.
unresolved_material_gaps: Congressional-transmission actual completion date is unheld. The October 23, 1992 Federal Register issue establishes a publication-completion bound, not the entire exact first-end chronology.
